stem.en: Which animal shows that "has a shell" cannot be the test for a mollusc?

text.en: Octopus: a mollusc with no outer shell

feedback.en: Right. An octopus is a mollusc with no outer shell, so the test would leave it out.

text.en: Snail: a mollusc with an outer shell

feedback.en: A snail passes the test correctly, so it shows no fault in the test.

text.en: Starfish: a hard skeleton inside the body

feedback.en: A starfish is not a mollusc and has no shell, so the test handles it correctly.

text.en: Earthworm: a soft body and no shell at all

feedback.en: An earthworm is not a mollusc and has no shell, so the test handles it correctly.

explanation.en: Many molluscs have a shell, but an octopus has no outer shell. Molluscs share a soft body, a distinct head and a muscular foot, and an octopus's foot has become arms and a funnel.

hints.en: Look for a mollusc that the test would leave out.
